'''Zeran Town''' located on the northern part of the [[planet]] [[Mon Cala]] under the rule of the [[Mon Calamari monarchy]].<ref name="Dark Lord 17" /> In [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[invasion of Mon Cala]], [[Governor]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] ordered an [[orbital bombardment]] of the planet from the Empire's [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyers]]. Zeran Town was one of many [[City|cities]] destroyed on the planet during the bombardment.<ref name="Dark Lord 17" />

Afterward, onboard [[Admiral]] [[Raddus]]'<ref name="Dark Lord 17" /> modified [[MC75 Star Cruiser]],<ref name="Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> the ''[[Profundity]]'', a [[Mon Calamari]] [[Unidentified Mon Calamari commander (Mon Cala)|commander]] reported to Raddus that Zeran Town had just gone offline and that all of its signals had stopped. The commander also noted that Zeran Town was the fifth northern settlement to be destroyed by the Empire.<ref name="Dark Lord 17" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zeran Town was mentioned in the [[Darth Vader (2017) 17|seventeenth issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series [[Star Wars: Darth Vader (2017)|''Star Wars: Darth Vader'']]. The issue was written by [[Charles Soule]] and published by [[Marvel Comics]]<ref name="Dark Lord 17" /> on [[June 13]], [[2018]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/68120/darth_vader_2017_17|text=Darth Vader (2017) #17}}</ref>
